name: God Helmet double session, part 1 of 2 (chirp right, then amygdala both sides)
origin: Todd Murphy (2018 interview; he cites one unpublished laboratory trial); base session from his Shiva God Helmet software
summary: First run of Murphy's 'double session': the 40-min God Helmet session (chirp over the right temporal lobe, then the amygdala signal over both sides), repeated unchanged 90 minutes later as part 2. Murphy (2018) says a few people 'would do one session and then wait 90 minutes and then do the exact same session again', and that in one unpublished laboratory trial of this design the EEG response to the second session was 'three times more robust than one session would have been alone'.
setting: Normal God Helmet conditions: darkness and acoustic silence, eyes closed or blindfolded; relax without meditating or falling asleep. The lab ran sessions mostly between midnight and 4 am during geomagnetic quiet. A helper can press Skip if phase 1 brings fear.
schedule: Start part 2 90 minutes after this part ends ('wait 90 minutes'), with no stimulation in between. Count both parts as one session and leave at least 7 days before the next God Helmet session (Murphy's 2013 advanced procedure: at most once a week, altered-state sessions only).
notes: Murphy's description (2018 interview, at 58:17, auto transcript): a few people did the God Helmet session 'using first the chirp signal over the right, making the right side more active, often with inner imagery followed by a blast of bliss', and 'they would do one session and then wait 90 minutes and then do the exact same session again'; 'in one of the trials of this session design, where two sessions are done back to back, in the laboratory', the EEG response to the second session was 'three times more robust than one session would have been alone'. No paper reporting that result was found. He does not say whether the 40- or the 60-min form was used. The 40-min form is used here as the more cautious choice: 80 min of stimulation in one evening instead of two hours (Murphy's Shiva rules say no session should run longer than 60 minutes; counted as one session, even the 40-min double runs 80 min). For the 60-min form, run murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-60min twice with the same 90-min break; that choice is ours, not Murphy's. The 90-minute rest cannot sit inside a program (60-min limit), so the protocol is split into two identical parts; each part is the same program as murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-40min. Murphy adds that the protocol 'has been available to people who use ... Shakti'. That fits his 2013 'advanced procedure' for the Shakti system, which may or may not be the same thing: the application page (archived January 2013) says it 'does not require any additional hardware or software', that 'a few early tests' found it to 'dramatically increase the intensity of altered state experiences', that it had 'only been tried for altered states' (not the feelgood session) and 'shouldn't be used more often than once a week'; its details went only to applicants who agreed on the application form not to disclose them, waived all claims to damages, stated that they had no psychiatric issues or damaged brain, and agreed not to repeat it after negative effects without contacting tech support; the page also rules it out with epilepsy, migraine or psychiatric medication. Murphy's Shakti software demo says the advanced procedure 'appears to make these sessions three times more effective'. That the two are the same rests only on the matching 'three times' claims (an inference). A different two-session use: in the Paranormal State episode 'Lady Vampire' (aired January 2009) an investigator 'did two sessions with a 90-minute interval between them' with the Shakti amygdala signal 'over the front-end of the temporal lobes' (Murphy's page). Phase 1 (20 min): the chirp on the four right coils only. Murphy expects it to be 'somewhat unpleasant for many people' (fear): press Skip to go to phase 2 at once, and don't make it an endurance contest. Phase 2 (20 min, abrupt switch): amygdala burst-firing on all eight coils. If anger or irritability appears during or after phase 2, do not run part 2 and do not reuse this session (Murphy's rule for it). Not for people prone to anxiety, or with epilepsy, migraine, brain injury, a psychiatric diagnosis or medication; no drugs or other mind machines; stop on any distress. Running the session twice in one evening breaks Murphy's God Helmet rule of no more than one session a week (his Shakti rule is one every 72 hours) unless the pair counts as one session. Approximations (as in murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-40min): the 'modulated 40 Hz chirp' and amygdala 'burstx' templates are proprietary. The chirp is approximated by a decelerating sweep from 40 to 6 Hz in 3-ms points, 2.5 s on and 1.5 s off, after the frequency-modulated lab pattern Murphy relates it to; the 40 Hz modulation itself is not reproduced. The amygdala signal is approximated by the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz, 230 points of 3 ms = 0.69 s), then the vendor's 4 s of silence. The coil step time is unpublished (Murphy: the rotation runs 'several times per second' and each cycle 'takes a fraction of a second'), so 62.5 ms per coil (4 cycles per second on each side) is used. 'Clockwise over the left side, counter-clockwise over the right' is read with each side seen from its own side, as Murphy's coil-numbered God Helmet animations show, so both sides step top, back, bottom, front (a 2021 image caption on his session list says the right side cycles clockwise; the text and animations are followed). Murphy's software plays phase 1 '10% higher than the volume level you entered (25% by default)' and says never to set the volume above 82%, the Shiva maximum being 92%; 82 + 10 = 92, so the step is read as ten percentage points (35% against 25% at the default): phase 2 runs at 0.71 of phase 1, and the session default is 1.4 µT so that phase 2 stays near 1 µT. Independent double-blind tests found no effect of the fields (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Revised Oct 2026 after a re-check of the sources: Murphy's own words with the interview timestamp, the conditions of the 2013 procedure (altered states only, at most weekly, no extra hardware or software), the Shakti demo's 'three times' remark and the Paranormal State precedent were added, and the reason for the 40-min form and the God Helmet weekly rule were stated more exactly. The program was then synced to the revised murphy-gh-chirpr-amybi-40min (4 cycles per second instead of 2, phase 2 at 0.71 instead of 0.91 of phase 1, default 1.4 µT instead of 1 µT) and is again identical to it.
